snippet.title: Announcing our new game Cozy Beach!
snippet.description:
We're working on new game called Cozy Beach where you can hang out with friends, go water tubing, get drinks, fish for treasure and more!  The Steam page just went up today, check it out and give it a wishlist!  🏝️ 😸
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=lb_youtube
